title: Private Trustee Administrative Decisions
description: The United States Trustee Program's duties include supervising private bankruptcy trustees. If a United States Trustee decides to suspend or terminate case assignments to a panel or standing trustee, that trustee may obtain administrative review of the decision from the Executive Office for U.S. Trustees. Links to these decisions are provided here, although certain information has been redacted in the interest of personal privacy

publisher.name: Executive Office for United States Trustees
